title: A Variational Optimal Transport Operator on Incompressible Flow
abstract: arXiv:2609.13729v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present the Variational Incompressible Optimal Transport (VIOT) operator, a generative neural operator for amortized incompressible density transport. Given a new source-target density pair, VIOT predicts a divergence-free velocity field and generates the full transport trajectory by feed-forward inference, replacing the hour-scale per-pair optimization used by adjoint fluid solvers and differentiable simulation baselines. The system consists of three components: a stream-function or vector-potential representation that enforces incompressibility by construction, a regularized incompressible transport objective that balances endpoint accuracy and flow smoothness, and a Fourier Neural Operator backbone that amortizes the solve across new pairs and grid resolutions. translated_title: 不可压缩流的变分最优传输算子
translated_abstract: 我们提出了变分不可压缩最优传输算子，这是一种用于摊销式不可压缩密度传输的生成式神经算子。给定一对新的源-目标密度对，VIOT通过前馈推理预测无散度速度场并生成完整的传输轨迹，取代了伴随流体求解器和可微仿真基线所采用的逐对小时级优化。该系统由三个组件构成：一种通过构造强制保证不可压缩性的流函数或向量势表示；一个平衡端点精度与流动平滑性的正则化不可压缩传输目标函数；以及一个能够在新的密度对和不同网格分辨率间摊销求解的傅里叶神经算子骨干网络。这些组件共同使不可压缩传输成为一个可复用的神经算子，从而支持各类传输过程。此外，其生成能力还进一步扩展了……
tldr: 提出了名为VIOT的生成式神经算子，通过流函数表示、正则化不可压缩传输目标和傅里叶神经算子骨干，将不可压缩密度传输从逐对小时级优化摊销为即时前馈预测，大幅提升效率。
en_tdlr: VIOT is a generative neural operator that amortizes incompressible density transport by predicting divergence-free velocity fields via feed-forward inference, replacing hour-scale per-pair optimization through a stream-function representation, a regularized transport objective, and a Fourier Neural Operator backbone.
